Qiao Wang: A 20x P/E Ratio Is Not Cheap for Trading Products

On September 15, 2026, Alliance co-founder Qiao Wang said on Good Game Podcast that a 20x price-to-earnings ratio is not cheap for trading products facing constant competition, citing Hyperliquid as an example. He argued that even 5x is high. With switching costs virtually zero on-chain, trading products struggle to sustain earnings over the long term. Valuations should therefore account for how long profits can last, rather than just current earnings. — l

BIS: Stablecoins and Bank Deposits Act as Substitutes as Deposit Hikes Slow Stablecoin Growth

BIS (Bank for International Settlements) working paper finds that stablecoins and bank deposits act as direct portfolio substitutes. Analyzing U.S. data, the authors show that a 1-basis-point hike in bank deposit rates cuts 10-week stablecoin market cap growth by roughly 3 percentage points (and up to ~9 percentage points under an IV approach). On-chain analyst Specter noted that following ZachXBT's disclosure regarding the Bitget exploiter shielding stolen assets via Zcash (ZEC), multiple other threat actors have begun channeling stolen proceeds into ZEC.
